[NGST.1.4] **The debug pack, and the wasm32 tarball.** Beside each libds tarball a
release ships a debug pack, named as the tarball is with `-debug` before
`.tar.gz`. It comes from the same build and differs only in this: its
`lib/libds.a`, and its `bin/dsc` where the tarball has one, keep their debug
information. The tarball's are stripped of it and keep their symbols, so both
link and run alike. An integrator must link against the one or the other, not
both.

The wasm32 tarball is named `ds-libds-<version>-emscripten-wasm32-regex.tar.gz`.
It carries no `bin/dsc` and no standard library, since a wasm archive is linked
into a module and not run: the compiler ([NGST.1.3]) comes from a native tarball.
